name: Violet Wake
look: Three staggered violet ribbons in the wake of a fast dash. Each twists around the path in a shallow S. Deep indigo edges frame a short magenta crest, and the staggered ends break into slivers.
subject: three ribbons following a rightward dash, with the figure as a scale guide

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: Three ribbons around one shallow S curve at peak brightness, with a clean silhouette and no detached fragments or halo

parts.name: RIBBON
parts.text: One narrow ribbon in profile, tapering to a point at both ends
parts.pivot: the forward tip on the movement path
forms: open S-curve with a wide crest
edge-on sliver with a broken tail

parts.name: FX
parts.text: Small detached indigo and violet slivers with the same curvature as the ribbon tail

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: A compact stepped violet halo around the hottest magenta crest

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: Ribbon silhouettes and their solid colour bands

rows.name: GATHER
rows.caption: staggered onset
rows.text: The start of the dash leaves thin hooked marks before the full stroke appears.
notes: A third strand appears behind the others
A violet streak runs through the longest strand

rows.name: SWEEP
rows.caption: crest crosses the trace
rows.text: The bands open into a long S as the dash accelerates, with a compact flash at the crest.
notes: A magenta core lights the middle band
The crest dims as the rear tips start to snap

rows.name: FADE
rows.caption: tail breaks up
rows.text: The dash ends and the remaining ribbons collapse along the recorded path.
notes: The older ends break into three slivers
The hot crest falls back to violet

rules: Use an indigo edge, electric violet body and a short magenta crest.
Keep the three leading tips staggered and close to the same movement path.
Use the guide figure for scale and keep it out of the painted layers.
